The [[Grote (system)|Grote system]] lies within the [[Glisten Subsector]] of the {{Sm}}.
* The mainworld of the system is [[Grote (world)|Grote]].

Note that this is an '''alternative version''' of the [[Grote (world)|Grote system]], containing far more rocky secondary worlds than the [[T5SS]] data indicates.

== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stars ===
'''Grote''' has a solitary primary star named ''Regis''.
* It is a white main sequence.

{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Grote
|primary        = F8 V 
|PrimaryName    = Regis 
|PrimaryNotes   = None
}}

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]]. It is the [[Natural Satellite|largest moon]] of the large [[gas giant]] [[Gas Giant|Aethelstan]].
* x8 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]]:
** Guthlac, a tiny [[Hot World|hot]] [[planetoid]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|0.2 AU]].
** Horsa, a [[Hot World|hot]] [[vacuum world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|0.5 AU]].
** Godwin, a [[Hot World|hot]] [[standard atmosphere]] [[desert world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|0.7 AU]].
** Edward, a [[Cold World|cold]] [[thin atmosphere]] [[hell world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|2.8 AU]].
** Edith, a [[Frozen World|frozen]] [[Big World|superterran world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|3.1 AU]].
** Ethel, a [[Cold World|cold]] [[vacuum world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|8.0 AU]].
** Adele, a [[Frozen World|frozen]] [[ice capped world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|12.0 AU]].
** Hengest, a tiny [[Frozen World|frozen]] [[vacuum world]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|40.0 AU]].
* x2 [[planetoid belt]]s:
** The Inner Belt, orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|1.0 AU]].
** The Outer Belt, orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|10 AU]].
* x4 [[gas giant]]s:
** Aethelstan, a [[Gas Giant|small gas giant]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|1.6 AU]]. <br> [[Grote (world)|Grote]], the [[mainworld]], is its largest moon.
** Cnut, a [[Gas Giant|large gas giant]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|5.2 AU]].
** Ethelred, a [[Gas Giant|large gas giant]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|20 AU]].
** Ethelbert, a [[Gas Giant|small gas giant]] orbiting at [[Astronomical Unit|77 AU]].

All of the [[gas giant]]s and most of the secondary rocky worlds [[Natural Satellite|retain moons]].

=== Mainworld Data ===
Grote is the [[Natural Satellite|largest moon]] of the [[Gas Giant|small gas giant]] ''Aethelstan''.

[[File:Gas Giant Moons 09d.jpg|600 px]]

The [[mainworld]] and its [[gas giant]] primary orbit within the [[star]]'s [[Habitable Zone]].
* They lie within the zones prime '''H''' region.
* They receive moderate levels of [[Electromagnetic Spectrum|stellar energy]].
* The gas giant is "puffy", warm and swollen due to the energy it receives from the star.

[[File:Chart Orbit HZ Region Detailed Satellite.png|600 px]]

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
The inhabitants of Grote more or less exclusively operate the starport and its associated facilities. The locals make their way as traders and ship-builders, with custom built small ships a specialty.{{Page cite|name=Behind the Claw|version=GURPS Traveller|page=95}}
